name: BBOB f19
description: BBOB f19 task evaluated in LLaMEA-BO: A Large Language Model Evolutionary Algorithm for Automatically Generating Bayesian Optimization Algorithms.

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.
notes: CPU Python with numpy, scipy, ioh==0.3.18; no provider credentials

evaluation.paper_metric: mean normalized area over log convergence curve

argv: from pathlib import Path; import json; from llamevol.evaluator.ioh_evaluator import IOHEvaluator; e=IOHEvaluator(dim=5,budget=100,problems=[19],instances=[[4,5,6]],repeat=5); e.ignore_over_budget=True; e.timeout=1800; e.max_eval_workers=0; r=e.evaluate(code=Path('Experiments/generated_algorithms/ATRBO.py').read_text(),cls_name='ATRBO'); print(json.dumps({'score':float(r.score),'metric':'mean normalized area over log convergence curve','direction':'maximize','valid':r.error is None,'error':str(r.error) if r.error is not None else None})); raise SystemExit(0 if r.error is None else 1)
commands.notes: Source-composed call to original IOHEvaluator, selecting only f19, dimension5, instances4/5/6, five repetitions and original ATRBO algorithm. Constructor and evaluate signatures inspected; command compiled but expensive optimization not executed.

evaluator_adapter.implementation_label: original IOH objective and released scoring class with repository bounded harness
evaluator_adapter.notes: Original ConvergenceCurveAnalyzer is compiled unmodified from the pinned source with a NumPy trapz compatibility alias. Repository harness enforces exactly100 finite in-bounds objective evaluations and verifies the returned observed best. Seed is a new lightweight GP/EI optimizer, not published ATRBO.

metrics.validation_scope: finite in-domain budget-complete trace and observed returned optimum; no paper reproduction

setup_instructions.notes: Minimal dependency subset for this adapter; avoids optional provider, Botorch, embedding and plotting frameworks.

task_setup_instructions.notes: Minimal dependency subset for this adapter; avoids optional provider, Botorch, embedding and plotting frameworks.

notes: Default direct-evaluation profile: official IOH BBOB function 19, dimension5, held-out instance4, exactly100 calls, one run, seed0.

Full paper evaluation: dimensions5/10/20/40, held-out instances4/5/6, budget10*d+50, five repetitions. Original broader commands are retained separately; the default adapter does not reproduce that complete experiment.
The released primary `.score` uses normalized trapezoidal area over log10 best-objective gaps clipped to [1e-8,1e4] at d5 (upper1e9 above d5). The separate IOH logger metric is not substituted.

Original class interface preserved: Optimizer(dim,budget)(func) returns(best_y,best_x). A new small GP/EI baseline keeps evaluation CPU-cheap. Strict complete-budget/finite/domain checks are added by this repository harness.

limitations: Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
